notes.title: "Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year" - Coming 2026
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Zombie Police development team.

We're excited to announce that the latest entry in the Zombie Police series,
"Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year"
is scheduled for release in 2026, and the Steam store page is now live!
Please add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for updates.

Store Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649840/_/
The mismatched detective duo takes on the mysteries of a traditional village!
The pair heads to "Sanjusanda City," Detective Tamura's hometown.
There, they discover a strange village that remains frozen like perpetual winter, even in the middle of summer—a place even Tamura has never known about.

The darkness hidden within the village, the truth lurking behind the case...
What is the reality of that tragedy involving a VTuber during a live stream?

Enjoy the same beloved comedy mystery atmosphere and social commentary, with the powered-up investigations of Detective Zomby and Detective Tamura.

*English localization may be available slightly after the Japanese release for better localization quality.
[hr][/hr]
Please add the game to your wishlist!
Thank you for your continued support of the Zombie Police series.

notes.title: Zombie Police: The Adventure Continues
notes.content:
How's everyone doing? It's the Zombie Police development team!

We have some exciting news along with today's update.

■ Zombie Police Launches on iOS!

Zombie Police is now available on the App Store! Enjoy the game on your iPhone or iPad.

The iOS version supports multiple languages (Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and French) from launch. Like the Steam version, it will receive updates with new side stories starting with "Convenience Store Chatter," as well as translation improvements.

  ▼ Download the iOS version here:
https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6737544859


■ Free Zombie Police Demo Available Now on iOS!

Try the first chapter, "The Namino Hotel Incident," for free! This demo features the same story content as the full iOS and Steam versions, so feel free to check it out before purchasing the full game.

  ▼ Download the free demo here:
https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6737910745


■ Nintendo Switch Version in Development!

Following the iOS release, we're also developing a Nintendo Switch version! We'll share more details, including the release date, soon.

■ Zombie Police Sequel Announced!

Due to the positive reception of Zombie Police, we're thrilled to announce a sequel is in the works! Stay tuned for more information on the continuing adventures of Zombie Detective Akemi Kabane and her partner, Yasu Tamura.

Thank you for your continued support! We can't wait to share more about the future of Zombie Police!

notes.title: 2024.08.08(JST) on Sale
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

We're thrilled to announce that "Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies" will be released on August 8, 2024! (JST)
Additionally, we'll be launching the game's complete soundtrack on the same day.

Pricing Details
- Base Game: $12.99
- Game + Soundtrack Bundle: $16.99
- Soundtrack Only: $6.99

To celebrate our launch, we're offering a 25% discount for the first 14 days after release!

Game Updates
We'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who played the demo and shared their feedback. Your input has been invaluable, and we've implemented the following improvements for the full release:

1. Fullscreen Mode
- Added a fullscreen button to the title screen

2. Audio Adjustments
- Implemented overall volume control
- Adjusted movie audio to match BGM levels

3. Text Speed Enhancement
- Increased the maximum text display speed

4. Performance Optimization
- Improved image processing for better overall performance

We're also enhancing various visual elements and illustrations to make your journey through the world of "Zombie Police" even more immersive.

All recent updates and improvements have already been implemented in the demo version.
Post-release, we plan to update the game with English and Simplified Chinese translations.

Events & Campaigns
We're excited to announce that "Zombie Police" will have a booth at "Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair 2024" on September 21-22!
We'll be selling original merchandise, so we hope to see you there!

A huge thank you to everyone who participated in our [Zombie Police: Demo Campaign] in June.
Winners will be notified via email or DM before the game's release date.

Thank you for your continued support of "Zombie Police".
We can't wait for you to experience the full game!

notes.title: Zombie Police News #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

Chapter 1 "The Namino Hotel Fall Case" Coming Soon!
We are excited to deliver a demo version of "Zombie Police" in preparation for the Steam Next Fest starting on June 10th (PT).
You can play the entire Chapter 1 of the main story!
It takes about 1-2 hours to get to the ending.

How to play "Zombie Police"
This game is a classic mystery game featuring the mismatched buddy duo of Detective Zomby and Detective Tamura.
You can enjoy simple yet genuine mystery-solving.
While conducting unique inquiries that only Detective Zomby can do, gather information at the crime scene and aim to uncover the truth.
The important information collected is registered as "TIPS" and can be reviewed at any time.

A feature of this game is that players can end the investigation and move on to the deduction phase at the point when they have a hunch about the culprit.
Let's proceed with the deduction together with Detective Tamura based on the information gathered.
Even if you fail in your deduction, don't give up - gather more information and try again.
Help may come from somewhere unexpected.

Future Information Releases and Campaigns
Prior to the release of Chapter 1, we plan to introduce each character on social media, so don't miss it!
Please also follow our official accounts.

Additionally, we are planning to hold a campaign where those who have played Chapter 1 have a chance to win a Steam key for the full version of "Zombie Police" in a lottery.
Please take this opportunity to play and participate.
The development team welcomes your feedback and gameplay videos!

Please look forward to the release of Chapter 1 first!
And we continue to appreciate your support for "Zombie Police".
